summary: High Court Justice Alex Stein rejected an interim-order request challenging the civilian powers granted to Smotrich as a minister in the Defense Ministry and ordered NIS 3,000 costs.
notes: Limiting/exculpatory legal status only. The reported decision expressly says the interim request was denied without addressing the prospects or merits of the underlying petition. Therefore this cannot be treated either as an adverse accountability finding against Smotrich or as a merits ruling validating the challenged arrangement. Broader May official/court/Knesset lanes remain open.
